input_validation: XAX b1 values only, extended to bytes 00/01; unknown facts never authorize
output: Status zero and exactly one byte 01 authorizes the scoped override; all other replies preserve native behavior
settings_page: YouTube > You > Settings > YoutubeHideAds > Player controls
setting_description: Allow videos to continue playing when YouTube is in the background or the screen is off, including Made for Kids videos.
reset: Existing preference clear restores the true default
lifecycle: Hooks read the saved preference on each eligible evaluation. Restart YouTube after changing the setting to discard native cached capabilities and experiment values. No automatic restart or play command.
readiness: All required roles must resolve uniquely, match typed structural relationships, pass startup checks and install successfully before any override is active
playback_context: Main thread, validated regular player enum, live weak player-view reference and no visible reel_watch_player in its root. Unknown, hidden, inline or dismissing players preserve native behavior.

effects.manager: Preserve native true; authorize false-to-true only for a non-null typed argument and validated regular player context
effects.kids: Skip only the uniquely identified kids background-policy controller, with both typed object arguments present and validated regular player context
effects.settings: Allow the uniquely identified background settings capability when preferences and the complete binding set are ready
effects.foreground_resume_flag: Disable only experiment 45770945, namespace 288 for the verified int/long/boolean accessor, or the verified legacy long/boolean accessor; all other keys pass through

failure: Discovery runs once on a worker. Missing, ambiguous or changed roles and policy failures leave readiness false. Protective hooks preserve native behavior on callback errors.
